objective: Use Branch Handoff Protocol v1 to prepare a deterministic, non-executable Tier-A Locked-Source Batch Manifest v1 for Lotus's, Big C, Makro, and Tops from merged acquisition evidence only, so a separately authorized long-running live campaign can later execute locked methods without exploration or technique switching.
instructions: Use branch_handoff mechanically: close this source queue before switching, then create/switch to codex/ku2d-tier-a-locked-source-batch-manifest-v1 from integration/data-acquisition-platform at exact merge commit f97ab206cf0c92563d20519b292a0eb7e949d604 and initialize the target queue as sole authority.
Scope exactly Tier A from KU2D-R-000032: Lotus's, Big C, Makro, and Tops. Exclude Gourmet Market, JIB, and every Tier C source. Do not reinterpret readiness tiers in this Prompt.

Use only merged durable evidence, approved source profiles, existing acquisition patterns, validation artifacts, fixtures, and runtime/tool contracts. Do not make any live or external request and do not browse source websites.

For each source, create an exact locked-method manifest entry containing source id/name, approved acquisition technique(s), exact discovery/detail surface types, current known official URL or URL-pattern provenance from merged artifacts, execution environment, allowed transport mode, allowed pagination behavior, request budget, page/item budget, concurrency cap, timeout/retry policy, expected minimum/target/maximum record range when supported by evidence, normalization contract, required product identity/price/provenance fields, price-role handling, repeatability policy, Deep Audit criteria, drift checks, stop conditions, exit 0/2/1 meanings, and evidence references.

Add deterministic tests covering positive Tier-A manifests and negative cases for source leakage, method switching, budget overflow, missing provenance, missing audit, missing drift/stop rules, unsupported exact URL claims, and proposal-vs-observed labeling. Preserve all existing regressions.

Produce a human-readable Tier-A Batch Preflight Report summarizing each source's locked method, confidence, known caveats, proposed workload, expected duration class, request budget, failure isolation behavior, and whether each source is ready_for_separately_authorized_live_batch or still blocked before execution.

Do not execute the batch, do not make live/browser/Edge requests, do not authorize Tier B inclusion, do not promote Candidate Learning Evidence or mutate Reviewed Corpus/Core Knowledge/Human Confirmation/Ground Truth, and do not touch parked refs, production, scheduler, ML, Survey/DoE/SEM, or cleanup.
Open/update a PR against integration/data-acquisition-platform, perform safe mechanical PR operations including Ready transition where possible, and do not merge.

Return completed_queue_summary with only important items: work completed; key findings/results; repo/knowledge state changes; important out-of-scope actions not performed; remaining blockers/risks; recommended next logical step.
